summary: Iteration 3 regression passed backend APIs and the primary mobile workflow: login/logout, store creation, explicit newly-created store selection, product creation, tenant-visible WAHA not-configured state, and CORS preflight.

ui_bugs.issue: A prior success notice (Produto salvo no catálogo) remains visible after logout and on the login screen because signOut does not clear notice state.

action_items: Clear notice state when logging out or when rendering the login screen.
critical_code_review_comments: Lockout implementation is present and source resets the failed-attempt count while setting a 15-minute lock; add this assertion to the reusable regression test if future changes touch auth.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST UI Iter3 Store and test-ui-iter3@example.com with TEST UI Burger 3 via the UI; no seeded records modified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: CORS preflight now returns 200 with allow-credentials and allowed origin. Explicit select_option by store label successfully routes product creation to the new store. Desktop was covered in prior iteration; this iteration covered mobile.
rca of the issue: The stale notice is retained in Panel state across signOut; Login receives the same notice state and displays it as an error-style message. Clear notice in signOut or reset it when switching to unauthenticated state. The browser automation's final DOM error-evaluation helper had malformed JavaScript, but all functional assertions completed successfully.
